# BioMan Biology

> > Interactive biology education platform featuring NGSS-aligned games, virtual labs, and animations covering molecular biology, cellular processes, physiology, and ecology.

BioMan Biology provides free educational resources for students and teachers, including interactive games like Snurfle Meiosis, Build a Body, and Digestive BodPod, plus comprehensive video tutorials on DNA, photosynthesis, cellular respiration, and body systems. All content aligns with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS) for high school biology.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- DNA structure and replication
- Photosynthesis and cellular respiration
- ATP and energy transfer
- Meiosis and genetic diversity
- Homeostasis and body systems
- Carbon cycle and ecology
- Molecular biology
- Helicase and DNA polymerase
- Calvin cycle and Krebs cycle
- Interactive learning games
- Virtual labs
- Scientific method
- Digestive system
- Muscle contraction

## Getting Started

- [Bioman Biology: The Fun Place to Learn Biology!](https://biomanbio.com): Homepage for BioMan Biology interactive games, virtual labs & BrainyBlast
- [BioMan Biology Students](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/students.html): Student portal for free biology games, YouTube videos, and study resources
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/video/video-landing-page.html): Biology video library: DNA, gel electrophoresis, cell membrane animations

## Molecular Biology & DNA

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/LifeChemgames/dna-structure-model-page.html): Interactive DNA structure and double-helix nucleotide model game
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Quizpages/Lifechemquizzes/dnaquiz1html5page.html): DNA structure, replication, and base-pairing quiz with helicase/polymerase

## Photosynthesis & Cellular Respiration

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/PhotoRespGames/photoresp.html): Photosynthesis & cellular respiration games: ATP, Krebs, Calvin cycle
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/PhotoRespgames/photointeractivehtml5page.html): Photosynthesis interactive: light reactions, Calvin cycle, rubisco, G3P
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/PhotoRespGames/molecular-models-page.html): NGSS molecular models game for photosynthesis and cellular respiration

## Genetics & Meiosis

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/GeneticsGames/snurflemeiosis2diversityhtml5page.html): Snurfle Meiosis 2: dihybrid crosses, crossing-over, genetic diversity

## Human Physiology & Body Systems

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/Physiologygames/physiology.html): Physiology games hub: Build a Body, Muscle Contraction, Digestive BodPod
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/Physiologygames/buildabodypage.html): Build a Body NGSS game: tissue types, homeostasis, body organization
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/Physiologygames/digestive-bodpod-page.html): Digestive BodPod game teaching digestive system anatomy and biomolecules

## Ecology & Environmental Science

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/membersite/Gamepages/EcoGames/carbonquest-page.html): Carbon Quest NGSS game: carbon cycle, photosynthesis, respiration
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/EcoGames/greenhouse-effect-page.html): Greenhouse effect interactive game on CO2 and climate heat transfer
- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/EcoGames/aaecology%20page.html): Angry Aliens ecology game: symbiosis, matter cycling, succession

## Scientific Method & Research

- [BioMan Biology](https://biomanbio.com/HTML5GamesandLabs/SciMethodGames/malariainteractivepage.html): Malaria scientific method interactive game on disease control
